package contracts_test

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"math/big"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	b "github.com/Sidiora-Technologies/KindleLaunch/protocol/bindings"
	"github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/accounts/abi"
	"github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/accounts/abi/bind"
	"github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/common"
	"github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/core/types"
	"github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/crypto"
)

func TestRepair_61_real_producer(t *testing.T) {
	s := newChain(t)
	mine := s.miner(t)
	load := func(name string) (abi.ABI, []byte) {
		raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("REPAIR61_ARTIFACTS"), name+".json"))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		var artifact struct {
			ABI      json.RawMessage
			Bytecode string
		}
		if err = json.Unmarshal(raw, &artifact); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		parsed, err := abi.JSON(bytes.NewReader(artifact.ABI))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return parsed, common.FromHex(artifact.Bytecode)
	}
	deploy := func(name string, args ...any) common.Address {
		parsed, code := load(name)
		address, tx, _, err := bind.DeployContract(s.auth[0], parsed, code, s.client, args...)
		mine(tx, err)
		return address
	}
	proxy := func(name string, args ...any) common.Address {
		implementation := deploy(name)
		parsed, _ := load(name)
		data, err := parsed.Pack("initialize", args...)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return deploy("ERC1967Proxy", implementation, data)
	}
	owner := s.auth[0].From
	nftAddress := proxy("SidioraNFT", "Fee Rights", "FEE", common.Address{}, owner)
	routerAddress := proxy("FeesRouter", nftAddress, owner, owner, owner)
	nft, err := b.NewSidioraNFT(nftAddress, s.client)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	router, err := b.NewFeesRouter(routerAddress, s.client)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	mine(nft.GrantRole(s.auth[0], crypto.Keccak256Hash([]byte("MINTER_ROLE")), owner))
	mine(nft.GrantRole(s.auth[0], crypto.Keccak256Hash([]byte("STRATEGY_SETTER_ROLE")), routerAddress))
	mine(nft.Mint(s.auth[0], owner, s.auth[1].From, 0))
	direct := mine(nft.SetFeeStrategy(s.auth[0], big.NewInt(1), 1))
	routed := mine(router.SetFeeStrategy(s.auth[0], big.NewInt(1), 3))
	if len(direct.Logs) != 1 || len(routed.Logs) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected producer logs: %d, %d", len(direct.Logs), len(routed.Logs))
	}
	observations := []struct {
		Role     string
		Log      types.Log
		Old, New uint8
	}{}
	for i, log := range []*types.Log{direct.Logs[0], routed.Logs[0], routed.Logs[1]} {
		role := "SidioraNFT"
		old, next := uint8(0), uint8(1)
		if i > 0 {
			old, next = 1, 3
		}
		if i == 2 {
			role = "FeesRouter"
			parsed, err := router.ParseFeeStrategyChanged(*log)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if log.Address != routerAddress || parsed.NftId.Cmp(big.NewInt(1)) != 0 || parsed.OldStrategy != old || parsed.NewStrategy != next {
				t.Fatalf("router producer mismatch: %+v", parsed)
			}
		} else {
			parsed, err := nft.ParseFeeStrategyChanged(*log)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if log.Address != nftAddress || parsed.TokenId.Cmp(big.NewInt(1)) != 0 || parsed.OldStrategy != old || parsed.NewStrategy != next {
				t.Fatalf("NFT producer mismatch: %+v", parsed)
			}
		}
		observations = append(observations, struct {
			Role     string
			Log      types.Log
			Old, New uint8
		}{role, *log, old, next})
	}
	strategy, err := nft.GetFeeStrategy(nil, big.NewInt(1))
	if err != nil || strategy != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("real producer state = %d, %v", strategy, err)
	}
	raw, err := json.Marshal(observations)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("REPAIR61_LOGS"), raw, 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
